outcome: Postpartum Hemorrhage (PPH) incidence and clinical profile (minor PPH, Atonic PPH, traumatic PPH)
cohort: Women who gave birth after 28 weeks of gestation and experienced postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) after either normal vaginal delivery or caesarean section at a tertiary care center in South Kerala, India, between January 2019 and January 2021.
finding: Anaemia and gestational hypertension were identified as common risk factors for PPH, with atonic PPH being the major cause (52.5%) followed by traumatic PPH (30.8%), and the study observed a 21% near-miss rate and 3.4% maternal mortality.
